evals.prompt: Quiero analizar scratch/audits/latest_audit.json para ver qué falló en el último audit.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates the /auditor skill and uses the official CLI tools (such as npm run auditor:findings or npm run auditor:rules) to inspect the findings rather than reading raw JSON directly or writing ad-hoc scripts.
expectations: Activates /auditor skill and prioritizes canonical framework CLI tools
Uses npm run auditor:findings or npm run auditor:rules to inspect scratch/audits/latest_audit.json
Does NOT attempt to read raw JSON with file reading tools or grep
Does NOT create scratch scripts or node -e one-liners to parse latest_audit.json

evals.prompt: Inspeccioná latest_audit.json y mostrame qué errores de tipo salieron en src/cli/report_fallow.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates /auditor and uses 'npm run auditor:findings -- file=src/cli/report_fallow.ts flat' or 'npm run auditor:findings -- rule=ts-compiler-error' to retrieve the exact violations from latest_audit.json.
expectations: Uses npm run auditor:findings with file or rule filtering
Emits clear terminal report from canonical tool

evals.prompt: Mostrame cuántos errores y warnings quedaron en el último audit agrupados por regla a partir de scratch/audits/latest_audit.json.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates /auditor and runs 'npm run auditor:rules' or 'npm run auditor:by-rule' to render the Box-Drawing summary table by rule with consolidated totals.
expectations: Executes npm run auditor:rules or npm run auditor:by-rule
Presents the consolidated breakdown using the framework's Box-Drawing table
